# LLM Integration Checklist: G56R-001 Candidate Route Baseline

**Purpose**: Validate requirement quality for official-only model, effort, candidate, and Codex-surface claims.
**Created**: 2026-07-15
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements. It tests requirements quality, not implementation behavior.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are official OpenAI documentation sources required for every model, effort, custom-agent, MCP, app, configuration, non-interactive, telemetry, and prompting claim? [Completeness, Spec FR-003, FR-004]
- [x] CHK002 Are repository files explicitly excluded from establishing platform or model facts? [Completeness, Spec FR-004, FR-005]
- [x] CHK003 Are roadmap seed models treated as execution-time candidates that can be retained, rejected, or blocked only through official source evidence? [Completeness, Spec FR-010, Workflow Official Candidate Seed]
- [x] CHK004 Are effort and default claims scoped per documented surface instead of treated as a global model property? [Completeness, Spec Candidate Route Record Shape]
- [x] CHK005 Are runtime capability checks required before any document-eligible candidate can be used by G56R-002? [Completeness, Spec FR-011, FR-012]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is the difference between document eligibility, runtime availability, exact treatment, and qualification clearly defined? [Clarity, Spec FR-011, FR-012]
- [x] CHK007 Are unsupported, deprecated, withdrawn, surface-mismatched, and undocumented model facts given clear candidate-status outcomes? [Clarity, Spec FR-006, Candidate Route Record Shape]
- [x] CHK008 Is the term `official_documentation` distinct from `project_input`, `runtime_verification_needed`, and `qualification_needed`? [Clarity, Spec TraceabilityRecord, Plan Authority Classes]
- [x] CHK009 Are provisional candidate route IDs, role bindings, source bindings, unsupported facts, and invalidation rules required in each candidate record? [Clarity, Spec FR-011]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK010 Do the spec, plan, and workflow agree that the implementation artifact is one canonical report? [Consistency, Spec FR-001, Plan Summary, Workflow Report Architecture]
- [x] CHK011 Do the spec, workflow, and technical roadmap agree on the five current roadmap seed model IDs after checklist remediation? [Consistency, Spec FR-010, Workflow Official Candidate Seed]
- [x] CHK012 Do candidate requirements consistently prohibit claims of availability, executability, qualification, preference, efficiency, fallback behavior, and exact treatment? [Consistency, Spec FR-012, Plan Implementation Approach]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK013 Can reviewers objectively count source, role, fixture, and unsupported-candidate outcomes for LLM-route admission? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec SC-001]
- [x] CHK014 Can reviewers determine whether every retained candidate binds official source evidence and a role contract? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec SC-002, SC-003]
